options.name: active_interface
options.description: Interface IPs used by the DNS Resolver for responding to queries from clients. For Virtual IPs you can specify either the IP, Description, or "IP (Description)".

options.name: cache_max_ttl
options.description: The Maximum Time to Live (in seconds) for RRsets and messages in the cache.

options.name: cache_min_ttl
options.description: The Minimum Time to Live (in seconds) for RRsets and messages in the cache.

options.name: custom_options
options.description: additional configuration parameters

options.name: dnssec
options.description: Enable DNSSEC Support

options.name: dnssecstripped
options.description: If enabled, DNSSEC data is required for trust-anchored zones.

options.name: domainoverrides
options.description: Domains for which the resolver's standard DNS lookup should be overridden.

options.name: edns_buffer_size
options.description: Number of bytes to advertise as the EDNS reassembly buffer size.

options.name: enablessl
options.description: Enable SSL/TLS Service

options.name: forward_tls_upstream
options.description: Use SSL/TLS for DNS Query Forwarding.

options.name: forwarding
options.description: DNS Query Forwarding.

options.name: hideidentity
options.description: id.server and hostname.bind queries are refused.

options.name: hideversion
options.description: version.server and version.bind queries are refused.

options.name: hosts
options.description: Individual hosts for which the resolver's standard DNS lookup should be overridden.

options.name: incoming_num_tcp
options.description: Number of incoming TCP buffers to allocate per thread.

options.name: infra_cache_numhosts
options.description: Number of infrastructure hosts for which information is cached.

options.name: infra_host_ttl
options.description: Time to Live, in seconds, for entries in the infrastructure host cache.

options.name: jostle_timeout
options.description: This timeout (in milliseconds) is used for when the server is very busy.

options.name: log_verbosity
options.description: The level of detail to be logged.

options.name: msgcachesize
options.description: Message cache size in MB

options.name: num_queries_per_thread
options.description: Number of queries that every thread will service simultaneously.

options.name: outgoing_interface
options.description: Utilize different network interface(s) that the DNS Resolver will use to send queries to authoritative servers and receive their replies. For Virtual IPs you can specify either the IP, Description, or "IP (Description)".

options.name: outgoing_num_tcp
options.description: Number of outgoing TCP buffers to allocate per thread.

options.name: port
options.description: Listen Port

options.name: prefetch
options.description: Message cache elements are prefetched before they expire to help keep the cache up to date.

options.name: prefetchkey
options.description: DNSKEYs are fetched earlier in the validation process when a Delegation signer is encountered.

options.name: regdhcp
options.description: Register DHCP leases in the DNS Resolver

options.name: regdhcpstatic
options.description: Register DHCP static mappings in the DNS Resolver

options.name: regovpnclients
options.description: Register OpenVPN clients in the DNS Resolver

options.name: sslcert
options.description: Description of the server certificate to use for SSL/TLS service.

options.name: state
options.description: Enable/Disable DNS Resolver

options.name: system_domain_local_zone_type
options.description: The local-zone type used for the pfSense system domain.

options.name: tlsport
options.description: SSL/TLS Listen Port

options.name: unwanted_reply_threshold
options.description: If enabled, a total number of unwanted replies is kept track of in every thread.
